web.description:
## The short version
Its pricing looks simple on the surface — a per-page credit model with a few subscription tiers — but two details catch teams off guard: the free tier is a **one-time grant, not a monthly allowance**, and structured extraction can run on a **separate token-based subscription** stacked on top of your plan.

## Trap 1: the free tier is one-time, not monthly
Firecrawl's free tier grants **1,000 credits once** — a lifetime allowance, not a monthly refill.

## Frequently asked questions
As of 2026-05-18 Firecrawl's free tier grants 1,000 credits one-time (a lifetime allowance), not 1,000 per month.
